mr_title: Redact protocol error log when hide-user-data-from-log enabled

expected_issues.title: The current implementation processes the query buffer before checking `server.hide_user_d…
expected_issues.description: The current implementation processes the query buffer before checking `server.hide_user_data_from_log` in `setProtocolError`, risking exposure of sensitive user data in logs. Move the redaction check to the beginning of buffer handling logic to immediately skip data processing when enabled.
expected_issues.source_text: The current implementation processes the query buffer before checking `server.hide_user_data_from_log` in `setProtocolError`, risking exposure of sensitive user data in logs. Move the redaction check to the beginning of buffer handling logic to immediately skip data processing when enabled.

expected_issues.description: The snprintf ternary expression for redacting long query buffers has mismatched types and incorrect argument structure, failing to suppress user data exposure when `server.hide_user_data_from_log` is enabled and causing potential crashes.
expected_issues.source_text: The snprintf ternary expression for redacting long query buffers has mismatched types and incorrect argument structure, failing to suppress user data exposure when `server.hide_user_data_from_log` is enabled and causing potential crashes.

known_false_positives.description: The protocol error log uses a non-standard redaction string; replace `[hide_user_data_from_log]Redacted` with the conventional `*redacted*` string for consistency.
